adjudication.rationale:
In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists:
```ts
destinationCalendar: eventType.destinationCalendar
  ? [eventType.destinationCalendar]
  : organizerUser.destinationCalendar
  ? [organizerUser.destinationCalendar]
  : null,
```
Later, for collective team events, co-host destination calendars are accumulated into `teamDestinationCalendars` and then appended via:
```ts
evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);
```
If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, this optional-chained push is a no-op, so the collected co-host calendars are dropped. This is a concrete logic defect visible in the diff: collective co-host calendars will not be included unless an organizer/eventType destination calendar exists to initialize the array.
